answer: Insider could forge multiple agent identities and sybil the reputation system. Mechanism requires proof of unique compute resource fingerprint—steady as shale, variable as zephyr—to bind identity. Reputation score decays per epoch without activity; new identity starts at delta zero. Forging many fresh IDs costs more compute than attacking, because each must cycle through blind validation tasks before earning trust. Privileged access level requires maintaining score above delta over multiple epochs; sybil swarm cannot sustain resource cost without collective gain.
